speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a group of 6 friends sitting together at a table in a restaurant. They are all smiling and talking to each other while enjoying their food. This can help them feel connected and happy, strengthening their friendship.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture very interesting because it reminds me of how sharing a meal with friends can create joyful moments and memorable experiences.

Step 3: I think, people should spend more time with friends in social settings like this because it helps us stay happy, relaxed, and emotionally connected.
speaking_tips.question2: Why do people like eating out with friends?
speaking_tips.question2_answer: People are keen on eating out because it is one of the great ways to spend the time and it is fun and enjoyable activity. Besides, people like to share food with family and friends. Actually, eating out has become one of the most popular ways of recreation. It is a time to be out, see people and meet people. You can enjoy the delicious food that you usually do not cook at home while smiling and talking with your friends about some fun stories. I think that’s why people are into eating out.
speaking_tips.question3: Please talk about the last time you ate with friends?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: The last time I ate with my friends was last night. Me and my group of friends went to a Chinese restaurant in the city center. The purpose we went to eat was to celebrate a friend of mine who passed his English test that morning. We enjoyed our meal a lot while smiling and talking about the beautiful memories of our life. The restaurant had a homely atmosphere and soft music that made me comfortable and helped me let my hair down after a working day.

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a family of five in a car. The father is driving while the mother is sitting next to him. Three kids are sitting in the back, all wearing sunglasses and smiling. This can help them feel excited and ready for their adventure.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture very interesting because it captures a fun and happy family moment, showing the joy of spending time together on a trip.

Step 3: I think, people should take family trips more often because it helps us bond, create memories, and enjoy time away from our busy routines.
speaking_tips.question2: Tell me the last time you traveled in a car?
speaking_tips.question2_answer: The last time I traveled by car was yesterday. I drove to HaLong city with my family, which is a coastal city in the north of Vietnam. It took us about 2 hours to get there and we had so many opportunities to experience the picturesque scenery along our way. We even pulled over several times to enjoy the gorgeous scenery and take some beautiful photos. I think that was one of the best experiences that I have ever had.
speaking_tips.question3: How can people overcome the time of a long journey?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: There are so many ways to help people pass the time on a long journey and create more memorable travel experiences. I think the most common one is that we can listen to our favorite music or read a book to kill time. If you don’t have the concentration to read books, then you should watch a film or TV series instead. Playing a fun game is also one of the best ways to make the time pass faster. In addition, carrying some snacks is also extremely popular, in case they feel hungry.

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a person holding a remote control in front of a TV. The TV screen displays various programs or movies that the person can choose from. This can help them feel entertained and relaxed as they choose what to watch.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture very interesting because it shows the convenience and variety of options available in modern entertainment.

Step 3: I think, people should enjoy their free time watching something they love because it helps us unwind and take a break from our daily routines.
speaking_tips.question2: How often do you watch films or programmers at home? Why?
speaking_tips.question2_answer: Well, I’m keen on watching TV because it is one of my favorite activities. I often watch films or programs at home in my spare time like the evening on the weekend with my family. We are into watching comedy TV programs or action movies because we want to enjoy the fun of family weekends. Sometimes I watch a football game with my father on the weekend. Watching movies not only helps me let my hair down after a hard-working day but also makes me happy and expands my horizons. I think watching TV is very interesting.
speaking_tips.question3: Which is better for learning, watching video or reading? Why?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: Personally, I prefer watching videos to reading books. The graphics in the videos attract me and help me understand better. Besides, watching videos is extremely suitable for introductions to difficult topics, especially something unfamiliar. Furthermore, watching a video takes me less time than reading a book with the same content. Moreover, learning through a video can make us feel more comfortable and relaxed than reading. It not only expands my horizons but also helps me let my hair down after a hard-working day. But if you combine these two methods you can learn the best.

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a person lying on a sofa, holding a remote control in front of a blank TV screen. This suggests that they might be looking for something to watch or are in a relaxed moment before choosing a show.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture interesting because it shows a peaceful moment where someone is unwinding and enjoying their free time at home.

Step 3: I think, people should take time to relax at home like this because it helps us recharge and enjoy some downtime away from the stress of daily life.
speaking_tips.question2: Do you often watch TV?
speaking_tips.question2_answer: I don't watch TV very often. I prefer spending my free time doing other activities like reading or going for a walk. However, I do watch TV occasionally, especially in the evening after a busy day. I enjoy watching movies or news programs to relax and stay updated.
speaking_tips.question3: Why is free time important?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: Free time is important because it allows us to relax and recharge. After working or studying, it’s essential to have time to do things we enjoy. This helps reduce stress and keeps us happy. It also gives us a chance to spend time with family or friends, which strengthens relationships. In short, free time helps maintain a healthy balance in life.

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a happy family of three lying in the grass. The mother and father are smiling, and the child is laughing, looking very joyful. They seem to be enjoying a fun moment together outdoors in nature.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture very interesting because it captures the happiness and warmth of a family spending quality time together, which is truly heartwarming.

Step 3: I think, people should spend more time with their families in natural settings like this because it helps us bond, relax, and create beautiful memories.
speaking_tips.question2: What do you usually read?
speaking_tips.question2_answer: Some kinds of books that I would prefer to read are romance novels, history books or science fiction books. During the holiday, science fiction is my favorite choice, such as exploring time travel, space travel, and future scientific and technological advances. I can sit and read these books for hours without getting bored, it not only expands my horizons and improves my mental health but also helps me to let my hair down after a hard working day.
speaking_tips.question3: Why is reading important for children?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: I suppose that reading brings many benefits to children, especially for children’s thinking and perception. Reading allows them to develop a better imagination and get more life information. When you start reading aloud to your child, you are basically giving them background information about the world, which helps them make sense of what they see, hear and read. In addition, I think reading is also good for children’s health because it helps them limit their exposure to electronic devices.

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a mother carrying her child on her shoulders in a beautiful outdoor setting. The child is pointing towards the mountains while the mother smiles, looking happy and proud. This suggests they are enjoying the natural beauty around them.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture very interesting because it captures the special bond between a mother and her child while they explore and appreciate the outdoors together.

Step 3: I think, people should spend more time in nature with their families because it helps us build stronger connections and creates unforgettable experiences.
speaking_tips.question2: When was the last time you visited a new place?
speaking_tips.question2_answer: The last time I explored a new place was about a month ago. I visited a charming little town in the countryside. The main square was surrounded by quaint cafes and historic buildings, creating a picturesque setting. I spent the day wandering through cobblestone streets, discovering local shops, and indulging in regional cuisine. The highlight was stumbling upon a hidden garden with vibrant flowers and a peaceful atmosphere. It was a refreshing experience, and I enjoyed the blend of history, culture, and nature in that new locale. Exploring unfamiliar places always brings a sense of adventure and discovery.
speaking_tips.question3: Why do people like to go to new places?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: People are drawn to new places for various reasons. The desire for adventure and exploration motivates individuals to discover different cultures, landscapes, and cuisines. Traveling to unfamiliar destinations provides a break from routine, fostering personal growth and creating lasting memories. It satisfies the innate curiosity to learn and experience new things. Whether it's the thrill of discovery, relaxation in a novel environment, or the chance to broaden one's perspectives, the allure of new places lies in the diverse and enriching experiences they offer.

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a couple cleaning up a room together. The woman is holding a blue bag, while the man is using a broom to clean the floor. They seem to be working together to tidy up the space.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture interesting because it shows how teamwork and cooperation can make household chores easier and more enjoyable, as they are doing it together.

Step 3: I think, people should share household tasks like this because it helps create a sense of partnership, makes the work lighter, and strengthens relationships.
speaking_tips.question2: Describe the last time you did some physical work.
speaking_tips.question2_answer: The last time I did physical work was about a month ago. It's Tet. Everyone has a custom of cleaning the house before the Tet festival and so does my family. I had to sweep and clean 2 floors and besides, my mother and I had to clean and rearrange the cupboard, bookshelves and 2 wardrobes. The last days of the year are always the busiest, when everything had to be completed and the house also needed decorating. Although those are very tiring and heavy tasks, I found that they helped to strengthen the bonds between family members because we could create many unforgettable times with each other.
speaking_tips.question3: Do you think machines will do all our hard work in the future? Why?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: In my opinion, I don't think that machines can replace humans. Although many labor-saving devices have proved to be very useful in helping us save time and effort when doing housework such as washing the dishes, doing the laundry or vacuuming, I still believe that only humans can do non-standardized tasks. Robots are good at repetitive tasks but lousy at dealing with varied and unique situations. Machines make human skills more important. So, rather than undermining humans, we are much better off thinking hard about how to up skill ourselves and learn how to work.

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a group of people having a video conference in a modern office. The woman in the front is presenting on a screen while others are participating remotely, visible on a large video display. The setting appears professional, with some individuals seated and others standing.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture very interesting because it shows how technology can bring people together from different locations, allowing for effective communication and collaboration in a professional environment.

Step 3: I think, people should embrace remote work and virtual meetings because it helps increase flexibility, connects teams globally, and enhances productivity in a modern workplace.
speaking_tips.question2: Tell us about the time you give a presentation. How did you feel?
speaking_tips.question2_answer: The last time I spoke in public was when I had to make a presentation about the benefits of nature. It was a project which was held by my club with the aim of raising public awareness about the environment and the measures to protect our nature. At first I was extremely nervous and scared. However I made sure that I knew what I wanted to say and I became more confident. I felt happy that I overcame my fear.
speaking_tips.question3: Why are people scared of public speaking?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: There are many reasons why people become afraid when having to speak in public. First of all, public speaking is an art that requires lots of courage, confidence and will-power. Most people lack this skill because of its challenging type of nature. Besides, people are afraid of public speaking because the look of a lot of people may make them feel shy and unable to express their feelings and their thoughts.

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a woman sitting on the deck of a boat, enjoying the view as the sun sets behind her. She is wearing a white dress and appears to be relaxing by the water, with a peaceful expression on her face.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture very interesting because it captures a serene moment of calmness and beauty, showing the tranquility of nature and the joy of spending time on the water.

Step 3: I think, people should take moments to relax in peaceful settings like this because it helps us recharge, appreciate nature, and find balance in our busy lives.
speaking_tips.question2: Tell us the last time you went to the sea?
speaking_tips.question2_answer: Honestly, I haven’t “gone” to the sea myself since I’m just your AI buddy, but if I could, I’d totally hit the beach whenever life feels too crazy. I’d imagine standing barefoot in the sand, feeling the waves tickle my feet, and just zoning out to the sound of the ocean. It’d be the perfect way to recharge. Maybe someday you can share your beach adventures with me—sounds like fun!
speaking_tips.question3: Why do some people dislike going to the sea?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: Not everyone’s into the sea, and that’s okay. Some people hate dealing with sticky sand getting everywhere, or they just can’t handle the salty water stinging their skin. Then there’s the fear factor—deep water and the idea of sharks freak some folks out. And let’s not forget the sunburns—ouch! For others, the sea might feel too quiet or even boring. Everyone vibes differently, and while some love the ocean’s

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a man standing at a train station, holding a smartphone in his hand. He appears to be checking something on his phone, possibly a message or train schedule, while waiting for his train to arrive.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture interesting because it shows the busy and modern life of commuters who are always connected through technology while traveling.

Step 3: I think, people should use their waiting time efficiently by checking important information or catching up on tasks because it helps save time and stay productive in our fast-paced world.
speaking_tips.question2: Tell me about the last time you used public transport
speaking_tips.question2_answer: The last time I used public transport was just a few days ago. I took the metro to meet a friend in the city. It was a pretty smooth ride, actually. The train was fairly crowded, but it was still faster than driving because I didn’t have to deal with traffic or finding parking. Plus, it was nice not having to worry about the stress of navigating through the city, so I just put on some music and relaxed. I actually enjoy using public transport when it’s easy and convenient!
speaking_tips.question3: How can we increase the number of people using public transport?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: To get more people using public transport, we could make it more convenient and reliable. This means better schedules, faster routes, and more frequent services. Also, making it cheaper or offering discounts might encourage people who usually drive to switch. Lastly, improving the overall experience—like cleaner buses, better seats, and free Wi-Fi—could make a big difference!

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a group of people in a movie theater. They are watching a film, and their expressions show excitement, surprise, or fear. Some are holding popcorn or drinks, while others seem completely immersed in the movie.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture interesting because it captures the wide range of emotions people experience while watching a thrilling or suspenseful movie, highlighting the power of cinema to engage audiences.

Step 3: I think, people should enjoy movies together in theaters because it helps us share emotions, enjoy collective experiences, and appreciate the art of film in a social setting.
speaking_tips.question2: Tell me about a time you laughed a lot.
speaking_tips.question2_answer: One time I laughed so much was during a camping trip with some friends. We were sitting around the campfire, telling stories, and someone started doing impressions of famous celebrities, but in the most random situations. At one point, they did a dramatic reading of a cereal box as if it was Shakespeare, and we all lost it. We couldn't stop laughing for like 20 minutes, even though it was just so silly.
speaking_tips.question3: Do you think people from different countries laugh at different things?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: Yeah, I definitely think people from different countries laugh at different things. Humor is so tied to culture and language. For example, in some cultures, wordplay and puns are huge, while in others, physical comedy or sarcasm might be more appreciated. Plus, the way people view social norms and taboos can change what’s considered funny, so a joke that works in one place might totally miss the mark in another.

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a woman and four young girls baking together in the kitchen. They are all wearing aprons and headbands, with the woman helping the girls mix ingredients in bowls. It looks like they are having fun preparing something delicious.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture very interesting because it captures the joy of family bonding, especially through cooking, and how cooking together can create lasting memories.

Step 3: I think, people should spend time cooking with their family because it helps strengthen relationships, teaches teamwork, and allows everyone to enjoy the process of making something special together.
speaking_tips.question2: How do people learn to cook in your culture
speaking_tips.question2_answer: Most people learn cooking from family—parents or grandparents are the first teachers. They pass down traditional recipes, and it’s usually a mix of watching, helping out, and eventually doing it yourself. Some learn by trial and error, experimenting with food at home. Nowadays, cooking shows, YouTube tutorials, and food blogs are super popular ways to pick up new skills or explore different cuisines. Schools sometimes offer cooking classes, too. It’s a blend of tradition, curiosity, and adapting to modern resources.
speaking_tips.question3: Why is it important for people to learn how to cook for themselves?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: Knowing how to cook is such a key life skill. It helps you eat healthier, save money, and control what goes into your meals. Cooking gives you independence—you don’t have to rely on takeout or someone else to feed you. Plus, it’s creative and satisfying to make something with your own hands. It’s also great for connecting with others; cooking for family or friends can be a way to bond and show love. And let’s be real, being able to whip up a tasty meal feels pretty awesome!

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a father helping his son ride a bicycle in a park. The child is wearing a helmet and smiling as the father holds onto the bike to support him. They seem to be enjoying a fun and supportive moment together.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture very interesting because it shows the loving guidance and encouragement that parents provide while teaching their children new skills, like riding a bike.

Step 3: I think, people should spend time teaching their children important life skills because it helps build confidence, strengthens bonds, and creates lasting memories.
speaking_tips.question2: In your country, do parents care about their children?
speaking_tips.question2_answer: Absolutely! Parents in my country put a lot of love and effort into raising their kids. They’re involved in their education, health, and hobbies, always wanting what’s best for them. It’s common for parents to sacrifice their own needs to provide better opportunities for their children. They’re also big on teaching life values, like respect and responsibility. And while every family is different, the idea of nurturing and protecting kids is a universal priority.
speaking_tips.question3: Why do parents care about their children?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: Parents care because their children are a part of them—there’s a natural instinct to protect, nurture, and help them grow. They want to see their kids happy, healthy, and successful in life. It’s also about love; there’s this deep emotional bond that makes parents want to give their kids the best they can. Beyond that, many parents see raising their children well as a way to contribute positively to the future. It’s rewarding for them to watch their kids thrive and become their own unique individuals.

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a group of children waiting in line to board a school bus. They are all carrying backpacks and some have lunch bags. The bus driver is greeting them as they get on the bus.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture interesting because it captures a moment of routine and excitement for children, as they head to school to start their day.

Step 3: I think, people should encourage kids to be on time and prepared for school because it helps them develop good habits and start their day in a positive way.
speaking_tips.question2: How do children go to school in your country?
speaking_tips.question2_answer: In my country, some children go to school by bus, some children go by car (with their parents or with a private driver), and some children walk to school. If the children live near the school, they walk. If the children live far away, they go by car or bus.
speaking_tips.question3: Is it common to live far from school in your country? Why?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: It is not common to live far from school in my country because there are many schools, so I don’t have to travel far to find a school. There are private schools and public schools in my country. The schools are not far from the houses. Also, the schools check where the parents live. The parents should live near the school.

speaking_tips.question1_answer:
Step 1: In the picture, I can see a man dressed in a bright yellow floral shirt and orange pants, striking different dance poses. He looks like he is having fun and enjoying the moment, possibly dancing to some music.

Step 2: For me, I find this picture interesting because it captures a playful and carefree moment, showing the joy of expressing oneself through dance and fashion.

Step 3: I think, people should embrace their unique style and enjoy life with confidence because it helps us express our personality and adds fun to everyday moments.
speaking_tips.question2: Do you like dancing? Why? Why not?
speaking_tips.question2_answer: No, I don’t like dancing. There are many reasons why I don’t like dancing. I don’t like dancing because I don’t like listening to music, I don’t think I’m good at dancing, and I don’t know how to dance.
speaking_tips.question3: On what occasions do people usually dance in your country?
speaking_tips.question3_answer: People usually dance in my country at weddings and other celebrations like birthdays. Everyone in the family dances together. Dancing is an important part of the party. When I dance with my friends and family, I feel very happy. I like dancing.

It’s all about the balance between having enough space and the convenience of being in a lively environment.

example.manager_example:
Dear Manager,

My name is An Nguyen, and I am a member of the Book Club. I’m writing to share my opinion about the announcement regarding inviting a famous author.

In my view, the plan is excellent and it also makes me feel inspired. If possible, I suggest inviting a bestselling contemporary novelist because their works are relatable to both students and the general public. In addition, we could ask the speaker to focus on “Stories that Mirror Modern Life” to improve engagement and social awareness.

I also recommend including a short reading from the author’s latest book, followed by a Q&A session. A feedback form at the end would help us gather opinions for future events. Thank you for considering my ideas. I look forward to your response.

Sincerely,

An Nguyen
